description.zh: 面向跨境电商卖家、外贸团队与海外代码构建等关键业务，系统讲解如何利用双订阅架构、Clash 自动化 Fallback 回退策略组与永久不过期流量包打造“永不断线”的工业级网络保障。
description.en: A strategic engineering guide for cross-border e-commerce, global teams, and CI/CD pipelines, demonstrating how to configure dual-subscription Fallback groups in Clash for zero-downtime operations.
